ValidationRule.description: Unknown pricing cannot be selected if there is a value in any of the price fields. It prompts user to enter values or a dash ( - ) in remaining fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(Unknown_Pricing__c = True, IF(OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Retrieval_File__c )), NOT(Retrieval_File__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Retrieval_Box__c )), NOT(Retrieval_Box__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Permanent_Withdrawal__c )), NOT(Permanent_Withdrawal__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Std_Journey_Charge__c )), NOT(Std_Journey_Charge__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Handling_Charge__c )), NOT(Handling_Charge__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Rush_Transport__c )), NOT(Rush_Transport__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Minimum_Storage_Charge__c )), NOT(Minimum_Storage_Charge__c = "-")), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( Admin_Fee__c )), NOT(Admin_Fee__c = "-")) ), TRUE, FALSE ), FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unknown Pricing cannot be selected if one or more pricing fields contain a value. Please either uncheck Unknown Pricing or remove the values from the pricing fields.
